question.problem: Find an expression that's equal to $\sqrt{5w^3} \cdot \sqrt{uv}$ by combining the radicals.
question.worked_solution:
We apply the product rule for radicals, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{5{w}^{3}}\cdot \sqrt{uv} & = \\ \sqrt{5{w}^{3}\cdot uv} & = \\ \sqrt{5uv{w}^{3}} & \end{aligned}
$$
